title: DeRay Davis & Glasses Malone React To Kanye West Eithering Diddy, Meek Mill, And Calling Himself This Gen's Michael Jackson
htmlContent:
In the latest episode of Drink Champs, Kanye West called out Diddy and believed that Meek Mill is a fed.

Kanye West delivered another explosive interview on the Drink Champs podcast on Revolt TV, which premiered on Saturday, October 15.

During his conversation with hosts N.O.R.E. and DJ EFN, Ye said he doesn't have any famous friends because nobody helped him when he asked for help on social media after allegedly claiming that his former wife, Kim Kardashian kidnapped her daughter North earlier this year.

The rapper-producer in Chicago then pointed his vitriol at Diddy and Meek Mill, which he both called "fake hard n****s."

"All these fake hard niggas, fuck you! All you fake hard niggas, fuck you!" he seethed. "Y'all can't shoot nobody noways."

Ye then suggested that Meek work with the feds and claimed that the Philadelphia rapper remains out of prison because he agreed with the feds to keep pulling Kanye's coattails.

Kanye seemed to compare himself to the late Michael Jackson.

"You shut the fuck up about Michael," he stated. "I'm Michael now. Every Michael you can think of, but mostly godfather Michael now."

Kanye's attacks on Diddy and Meek follow his outlandish remarks about the fallen martyr George Floyd. During his conversation, the Chicago-produced rapper said he believed that George Floyd died of fentanyl and that the policeman's knee was not "on his neck like that."

In the comment section of both IG clips DeRay Davis and Glasses Malone sound off on West comments on Meek and Diddy.

"U just said I was your friend 2 weeks ago NIGGA!!! okay fine give me my skits back," said Davis.

Malone added, "Revenge of the nerds."
